_comment: Pre-registered backtest. Written and committed before any NISAR value inside these boxes is read. The screening rules are pipeline/config.json, unchanged; only the box, the truth and the windows differ per site. Sites, boxes and windows come from a metadata-only ASF search (no granule opened).

metrics.positive_pass: same as config.pass_condition: a patch within truth.hit_radius_km of the truth and draining to the same channel ranks in the top config.pass_condition.top_n in BOTH of the last two ascending windows before the event
metrics.rank_series: for every ascending window from the first available pair to the event, the rank of the best hit patch (or not ranked)
metrics.false_alarm: a valley other than the truth valley that ranks in the top top_n in two consecutive ascending windows. A valley is a cluster of ranked patches within truth.hit_radius_km of each other that drain to the same channel. Counted per box over the same windows, including Langtang.
metrics.false_alarm_rate: false alarms per box per 12-day pass, over the summer windows (pre-event windows for positive sites; 20 Jun to 6 Oct ascending windows for the control)

langtang.role: development event (rules written after it); reported, not counted as a test

budhigandaki.event: Budhi Gandaki rock-slope failure, Chamar south face (Ungilung Khola), became a rock avalanche and debris flow
budhigandaki.event_source: https://eos.org/thelandslideblog/budhi-gandaki-2 (time from a seismic record, location from Sentinel-2 of 21 Oct)

truth.kind: approximate scar point (no UNOSAT or Copernicus EMS outline exists)
truth.note: The point is approximate. A 2 km hit radius around a point is stricter than around a 2 km2 outline.

manang.role: negative control (no recorded failure in the period found by search; not proof of none)
manang.windows: all A098 ascending pairs from 2026-06-20 to 2026-10-06
manang.note: Same A098 granules as Langtang and Budhi Gandaki. Contains 11 of Meena's moving zones, 2 not on glaciers.

not_run.lete_kali_gandaki: location speculative, rain-triggered; needs an optical scar map first
not_run.weisshorn_randa: small, partial ice break-offs; sensitivity test only
not_run.others: no pre-event GOFF, stale coverage, or too small for 80 m cells (see the search notes)

_committed.subject: Pre-register backtest: Budhi Gandaki positive, Manang control
